verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an orchestration framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no batch API, fan-out or map-reduce over many items, or other bulk-operation feature. The only related evidence is community remarks about built-in parallelism and Pregel/BSP orchestration. That is a general execution primitive, not a documented capability for operating on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
